It adapts George R.R. Martin’s Tales of Dunk and Egg novellas (also collected as the book A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms), starting with “The Hedge Knight.”The show follows Ser Duncan the Tall (Dunk), a large, honorable but naive hedge knight (a wandering, lowborn knight without a lord), and his young squire Egg—who is secretly Aegon Targaryen, a prince in disguise (shaved head to hide his royal hair). Their adventures involve tourneys, honor, intrigue, and unlikely friendships in a Westeros where the Targaryens still rule and dragons are recent memory.It premiered on January 18, 2026, on HBO and Max (formerly HBO Max), with Season 1 consisting of 6 episodes (around 30-40 minutes each, shorter format than typical GoT). Episodes dropped weekly on Sundays at 10 p.m. ET/PT.
